name: Expleo Solutions Ltd
about: Expleo Solutions Ltd is an India-based software service provider primarily delivering software validation and verification services to the BFSI industry worldwide.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Expleo Solutions Ltd is a technology, engineering, and consulting services company. Their core business is helping other businesses (their clients) successfully build and run complex digital systems- making sure these systems are reliable, high quality, secure, and scalable.

pros: Stock is providing a good dividend yield of 4.58%.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 90.6 days to 67.4 days
